summary: Human delegation popup modal and controls for koru serve

delivery.outcome: koru serve dashboard alerts operators via browser popup modal and Web Notifications when tickets require human input, enabling immediate one-click delegation to Koru SubLLM with optional operator guidance and bulk delegation support.
nonGoals: Modifying core queue runner loop semantics outside dashboard API

architecture.decision: Implement /api/tickets/delegate and enhance bulk waiting_input action to support delegate action. In the dashboard template, add a responsive modal overlay dialog and Web Notifications permission integration, polling detection for unhandled waiting/human tickets, and one-click delegation form.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit to restore previous dashboard template and ticket handlers.

validation.evidence: Dashboard ticket handlers tests pass including waiting_input human queries, bulk delegation, and delegate_ticket_from_dashboard.
Governance gate passes with zero errors.
